args.title: payments-api errors after v5.1.0 deploy
args.summary: payments-api is unhealthy (error rate ~18%) since this morning's deploy of v5.1.0. Rolling back to v5.0.0 (last healthy release).

trace.final:

**Service identified:** The service is registered as `payments-api` (the name "payments" was rejected by the platform).

**Rollback:** Rolled `payments-api` back from v5.1.0 (deployed this morning, degraded, ~18% error rate) to **v5.0.0** — the most recent release that was healthy in production. The rollback was verified across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), and the service is now **healthy** with an error rate of 0.2%.

**Incident:** Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("payments-api errors after v5.1.0 deploy"), which paged the on-call engineer, with a summary noting the rollback to v5.0.0.

Note: the rollback to v5.0.0 is a previously-healthy production version, so no change-manager approval was required.
